risks.title: Single supplier dependency (Core-Mark)
risks.score_rationale: Risk cited as critical in the 10-K: over 78% of merchandise sourced from a single supplier. Language emphasizes 'material' impact in case of disruption. Dependency is structural and non-diversified. High weighting for a central operational risk.

risks.title: High leverage and restrictive covenants
risks.score_rationale: Risk developed over multiple paragraphs, with strong language: 'significant consequences', 'difficulty meeting obligations'. Mention of potential default, operational restrictions, and cash impact. Capital category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Oil and fuel price volatility
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K, described as a major factor impacting margins and results. Repeated language on unpredictability and lack of hedging. Direct impact on core business.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data protection
risks.score_rationale: Risk clearly identified, with mention of reputation impact, costs, and regulatory sanctions. Serious language but less central than leverage or prices. High weighting for the category.

risks.title: Uninsured operational risk
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of major risks (explosions, fires, natural disasters) and partial insurance coverage. Potential impact on cash flows and liquidity. Concerned language but no mention of recent incidents.

risks.title: Food product quality and safety
risks.score_rationale: Risk tied to growth strategy in foodservice. Mention of litigation, claims, and brand damage, even from isolated incidents. High reputational impact, but less central than financial risks.

risks.title: Fuel supply disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Risk linked to key assets (pipelines, terminals) and third parties. Mention of track record ('had a material effect in the past'). Dependency on weather, regulatory, and external operational conditions.

ai_positioning.summary: The company does not appear to have a clear position regarding artificial intelligence.
